dz: 第七次奥斯曼-威尼斯战争:奥斯曼帝国俘虏了威尼斯共和国"莫雷亚王国"的首都瑙普利亚,从而为奥斯曼迅速重新征服莫雷亚开辟了道路.
de: Seventh Ottoman–Venetian War: The Ottoman Empire captures Nauplia, the capital of the Republic of Venice's "Kingdom of the Morea", thereby opening the way to the swift Ottoman reconquest of the Morea.

dz: 由12艘船只组成的西班牙宝藏船队从古巴哈瓦那出走去西班牙后7天,其中11艘在佛罗里达州近海的风暴中下沉. 几个世纪后,宝藏被从这些残骸中取出.
de: Seven days after a Spanish treasure fleet of 12 ships left Havana, Cuba for Spain, 11 of them sink in a storm off the coast of Florida. A few centuries later, treasure is salvaged from these wrecks.
